dedupe_keys.name: hitisea south and east asia thermal stress indices

description: The HiTiSEA research team publishes daily thermal-stress grids for South and East Asia from 3 January 1981 to 31 December 2019. The own collection describes 0.1-degree grids derived from ERA5 and ERA5-Land, including indoor, shaded-outdoor and unshaded-outdoor UTCI, mean radiant temperature and eight other indices. It reports 14,242 daily NetCDF files packaged into monthly archives, plus validation and metadata. Access is free; inspected monthly examples and supporting deposits state CC0. The fields can drive heat-exposure and building-demand simulations alongside data-era5-reanalysis and model-energyplus. A caveat is that derived indoor indices are simplified environmental representations, not measurements inside particular buildings. The collection's 471-item inventory was paginated fully, but individual values and all 468 monthly packages were not downloaded or checked. Station validation files report monthly and yearly error statistics, which users should examine before local application.
